source_text: Nascuntur Moab et Ammon — populi carnales adversus Israel. Qui de ebrio sensu nascuntur, hostes sunt spiritalis Israel.
pass_a_gloss: Are-born Moab and Ammon — peoples fleshly against Israel. Who from drunken sense are-born, enemies are of-spiritual Israel.
pass_b_english: [[Moab and Ammon are born >> Bible:Genesis 19:37-38]] — fleshly peoples against Israel. What is born of drunken sense becomes enemy to spiritual Israel.
